name: Geometric Bold
blurb: Bauhaus and constructivist poster energy: pure black on white, primary-color blocks, 4px hard borders, zero shadows or gradients, oversized black uppercase type, asymmetric layouts.

tagline.en: Bauhaus blocks, hard edges, no shadows
tagline.zh: 包豪斯色块，硬边框，零阴影
